reviewNotes: Published crate archive SHA-256 265332babe807f64b800b1a47d6d39e6897f249c153b962a6b1050f073816342. Exact source: https://github.com/houseme/rustfs-mimalloc/tree/c8777e0869e55f2d64c3947cc5f74651a61a1f6c (tag v0.7.1). The package declares Apache-2.0 but omits its root LICENSE. Retain the exact revision's LICENSE, fetched from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/houseme/rustfs-mimalloc/c8777e0869e55f2d64c3947cc5f74651a61a1f6c/LICENSE, including houseme copyright, Apache grant, patent terms and disclaimer. No root NOTICE file exists at that revision. Third-party source is unmodified. Also retain the packaged Microsoft Corporation/Daan Leijen MIT copyright, permission and disclaimer. All 89 packaged native include/src/LICENSE files match Microsoft mimalloc commit b5d94fe81c3b710499aaed3956b02fb1a8febb94 byte-for-byte; no upstream include/src file is missing. That commit is the wrapper revision's submodule pin, an unreleased dev3 snapshot and an ancestor of the official v3.6.0 tag. Source: https://github.com/microsoft/mimalloc/tree/b5d94fe81c3b710499aaed3956b02fb1a8febb94. LICENSE is unchanged since v3.5.3, and every native file header names Microsoft Research and Daan Leijen (the Emscripten primitive also Alon Zakai) under that MIT license. Both Apache-2.0 wrapper and MIT native obligations apply. The workspace enables only no_profile, which compiles native 30600 with MI_PROFILE=0 and no malloc override, secure/debug, no_thp or CPU-baseline feature; native/import closure remains subject to final release verification.
